content: If CanNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE and CanNm_DeactivateTxPnShutdownMsg is c alled with a valid NM - Channel ( nmChannelHandle ), then the CanNm module shall consider the PN shutdown message transmission as inactive on the given NM - channel, set PNSR bit in the CBV to 0 and return with E_OK.
